stem: Across two cycles, one bench has repeated lower-canopy humidity retention and weaker interior development despite normal room averages. What should be tested first?
choices: Whether architecture and local airflow create a persistent interior microclimate before changing room-wide setpoints
Whether fertilizer concentration should be raised for the whole room
Whether all sensors should be removed
Whether flower maturity is occurring too early
rationale: Repeated bench-specific interior conditions point toward a local architecture/airflow interaction that should be verified before broad environmental changes.
